notes_for_editor: Standing status rests on two sources, the 2014 MPS extant list and the tnlandforms list (undated). No build date, owner, staffing, fires or access found in what we read. Do not confuse with the Wilson County Hurricane (tnlandforms WLT001, 794 ft), which is a separate tower in the same MPS table. A Moore County or Division of Forestry inquiry would be the next step for history.
